slides.title: A long trip
slides.text: Will travels for twelve hours. He arrives at the Maple Hotel at nine in the evening. He is tired and hungry. Cleo gives him a key and a map of the city. His room has a comfortable bed, a window and a small desk. He sleeps well and wakes up for breakfast.
slides.pt: Will chega cansado ao hotel, recebe a chave e dorme bem.
